preconditions.description: The number of strings is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string has a length between 1 and 100.
Each string consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES\n'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all(strings[i] in strings[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each string is a substring of all subsequent strings.
